# ArtemisOS 1.0.6 display runtime — third-party materials

Read NOTICE.txt for components, full-license filenames, source access and user
replacement/debugging rights. sources.json pins all binary, notice and source
archive hashes. BUILDING.md records original build recipes and evidence limits.

Complete sources are separately offered at the same public distribution place:
https://cloudx.playones.com/sd/YCsIY2UB/sources/ArtemisOS15-Display-Sources-1.0.6.zip?d

Relative to update/server.txt: sources/ArtemisOS15-Display-Sources-1.0.6.zip
(preserve ?d). The publisher must upload and verify public read access before
publishing binaries. Complete source is optional to download; upstream links
alone do not fulfill this delivery route.

The original runtime DLLs are unmodified and replaceable. Preparation hashes
protect publishing inputs; ArtemisOS imposes no runtime hash lock on LGPL DLLs.
The frontend does not ship scrcpy's ADB; it uses the existing installation ADB.

The project-only source-archives/ and dist/ directories hold complete archives
and the source ZIP. Ordinary installations/OTAs carry only lightweight notice,
license, build-recipe, manifest and evidence files. No claim of byte-identical
reproducibility, independent OpenPGP verification or completed public source
publication is made by preparation alone.
